Every reference below was checked against the publisher, a DOI record (Crossref), PubMed or CRAN on 26 October 2026. The evidence for each item, and the few details that could not be fully confirmed, are recorded in `references/verification_report.md`. Package versions are those current on CRAN on that date. The versions used to run the course are recorded in `renv.lock`.

The course follows the approach of Verbeke and Molenberghs [-@verbeke2000] for linear mixed models and Molenberghs and Verbeke [-@molenberghs2005] for discrete outcomes. Molenberghs and Verbeke [-@molenberghs2017] give a compact overview of the field in *Wiley StatsRef*.
